CS1: DC 1 mA into 1k -> V = I*R = 1 V
CS2: pulse 0..2 mA into 1k || 100n -> RC charging, tau = 100 us, final 2 V
CS3: ramp 0..2 mA (0.2 ms delay, 1 ms) -> voltage ramp 0..2 V

CS4: behavioural current source, I = i(R1)+i(R2)+i(R3): the sum of the three resistor currents (device currents work like in LTspice, the netlist adds the 0 V sense sources itself). R4 turns it back into V = 1 k * sum.

Tip: click into the Equation field, switch to Probe mode and click nets to insert v(net).

div.div: CS1: DC 1 mA into 1k -> V = I*R = 1 V
CS2: pulse 0..2 mA into 1k || 100n -> RC charging, tau = 100 us, final 2 V
CS3: ramp 0..2 mA (0.2 ms delay, 1 ms) -> voltage ramp 0..2 V
CS4: behavioural current source, I = (v(vr1)+v(vr2)+v(vr3))1e-3 -> the sum of the three source currents, derived from the voltages across the 1k resistors. R4 turns it back into V = 1 k sum.
Tip: click into the Equation field, switch to Probe mode and click nets to insert v(net).
